title: Avskanta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Avodah Zarah 1:9. Seder HaDorot considers it the name of a sage, but Hyman says it is a Roman expression conveying honor, as explained in the Arukh. Berakhot, chapter 9, at the end of halakhah 1, reads Avskata.[^1]

notes.text: חלוק כבוד means showing or according honor here, not a garment of honor. Hyman rejects treating Avskanta as a sage’s name. The Guggenheimer text of Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:9 uses Abaskanta in the discussion of a blessing over beauty; it does not describe an item of clothing. The Roman-language explanation remains Hyman’s report of the Arukh.
